identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study to See How Well and How Safely Different Treatments Work in a Group of Participants With Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I-II, Multicenter Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Multiple Therapies in Cohorts of Patients With Resectable Stage I-III Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, Selected According to Biomarker Status

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The objective of this study is to explore the safety of alectinib in combination with chemotherapy in participants with resectable NSCLC. Cohort B1 is a phase II cohort that will assess the safety of alectinib in combination with up to four cycles of platinum-based chemotherapy in the adjuvant setting post complete surgical resection.

armGroups.label: Cohort B1
armGroups.description: Participants will receive alectinib in combination with a platinum-based chemotherapy for up to 4 cycles (cycle length = 3 weeks), followed by alectinib monotherapy for up to 2 years.

interventions.name: Alectinib
interventions.description: Participants will receive oral alectinib twice daily (BID) for up to 2 years.

interventions.name: Cisplatin
interventions.description: Participants will receive intravenous (IV) cisplatin on Day 1 of each cycle for up to 4 cycles (cycle length = 3 weeks).

interventions.name: Carboplatin
interventions.description: Participants will receive IV carboplatin on Day 1 of each cycle for up to 4 cycles (cycle length = 3 weeks).

interventions.name: Pemetrexed
interventions.description: Participants will receive IV pemetrexed on Day 1 of each cycle for up to 4 cycles (cycle length = 3 weeks).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence, Type, and Severity of Adverse Events (AEs) With Onset up to 28 Days After the Last Dose of Chemotherapy
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 28 days after the last dose of chemotherapy treatment (up to 4 cycles, cycle length = 3 weeks)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence, Type, and Severity of AEs With Onset up to 28 Days After the Last Dose of Study Treatment or Until Last on Site/Discontinuation Visit, Whichever Comes First
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From first dose to up to approximately 2 years

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Complete resection of the primary NSCLC with negative margins
* Confirmed stage II to select stage IIIB (T3N2) NSCLC of non-squamous (adenocarcinoma) histology
* Eastern cooperative oncology group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1
* Documented ALK fusion

Exclusion Criteria:

* NSCLC of squamous or mixed histology regardless of the presence of an ALK mutation
* Prior exposure to any systemic anti-cancer therapy
* Pregnancy or breastfeeding, or intention of becoming pregnant during the study
